title: Commercial Tower in Riyadh
shortDescription: Aluminum and glass facade installation for a 20-story commercial tower in the heart of Riyadh
description: A large-scale project encompassing the design and installation of full glass facades for a 20-story commercial tower in the Al Olaya district of Riyadh.
challenge: The primary challenge was executing the inclined glass facades at a 15-degree angle while ensuring thermal insulation under Riyadh's extreme heat.
solution: We used high-performance reflective double glazing with specially treated aluminum frames to withstand wind and thermal loads.

testimonial.name: Eng. Ahmed Al-Khalidi
testimonial.content: The Al Fahd team exceeded our expectations in execution quality and schedule adherence. We thank them for their exceptional professionalism.

title: Luxury Villa Complex in Jeddah
shortDescription: Integrated glass and aluminum works for a complex of 50 luxury villas in Jeddah
description: A luxury residential project covering the design and installation of all glass and aluminum works for a complex of 50 luxury villas.
challenge: Unifying the design across 50 units while preserving the architectural distinction of each villa.
solution: We developed a modular component system enabling rapid customization while maintaining unified quality standards.
results: Architectural distinction recognized with design award

testimonial.name: Eng. Sara Al-Zahrani
testimonial.content: Al Fahd is a team that works with high methodology and discipline. Quality and speed together are rare in the market.

title: Industrial Warehouse in Dammam
shortDescription: Large steel structure for a 5,000 sqm industrial warehouse
description: Design and execution of the complete steel structure for a first-class industrial warehouse in the Dammam Industrial Area.
challenge: The industrial zone site requires strict safety and durability requirements with rapid delivery.
solution: We used prefabricated galvanized steel structures with quality-controlled welds to ensure durability and speed.
